title: Stop Pitching Corporations. Start Building Real Partnerships.
actionable_recommendations: Shift mindset from pitching to matchmaking in corporate partnerships.
Identify overlapping goals, values, and audience with potential corporate partners.
Utilize employee engagement as an entry point for partnerships.
Translate existing programs to align with corporate goals.
Focus on building relationships instead of creating new programs.
Prioritize storytelling and clarity over perfection in communications.
claims_requiring_current_verification: The average nonprofit can raise between $20K–$100K in about 90 days.
Small and mid-size nonprofits bring unique value that larger corporations may lack.
major_ideas: Small nonprofits have an edge due to their community connection.
Corporate partnerships begin with human relationships.
Trust and authenticity are critical in partnerships.
Existing programs can serve as groundwork for corporate partnerships.
prerequisites: Clarity about existing programs and their relevance to potential partners.
proposed_workflow: Approach potential partners from a place of mutual benefit.
Assess alignment between nonprofit and corporate values.
Utilize employee engagement to cultivate initial relationships.
Leverage storytelling to build trust and relatability.
tools_templates_resources: Corporate Partnership Blueprint from Philanthropy Fuel.
